decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks with URL, title, description, and tags'. round 1 client: 'This gives me what I need to save...'
decisions.note: Saving a bookmark by entering a URL conforms to reference. Prototype review; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks'. round 1 client: '...edit, and remove bookmarks'.
decisions.note: Delete a bookmark conforms to reference. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'edit ... with URL, title, description, and tags'; modal editor. round 1 client generic approval.
decisions.note: Editing url/title/description/tags is present and conforms. The note field of REF-BM-04 is tracked separately under REF-BM-23. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Tags — comma-separated ... assign'. round 1 client: '...organize...'.
decisions.note: Assigning one or more tags conforms. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'the sidebar shows each tag with a live count, click to filter'. round 1 client generic approval.
decisions.note: Selecting a tag to filter to that tag's bookmarks conforms. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: title/description entered manually, 'empty titles are rejected server-side'; auto-metadata only offered as a future direction ('auto-fetching page titles/metadata from the URL ... Want any of those?'). round 1 client: 'I'm happy with the application as it is.'
decisions.note: Reference requires automatic collection of title/description/favicon/preview on save; the build requires manual entry and merely offers this as a future option. The client's bare approval declines it without expressing the expectation. Prototype review / offered choice; approval alone does not establish awareness.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'responsive card grid' exposing title/URL/description/tags; no favicon (no metadata collected). round 1 client generic approval.
decisions.note: Reference list must expose favicon per item; the presented list lacks favicon. Passes on bare approval. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Tags — comma-separated, auto-deduplicated/lowercased'; no autocomplete of existing tags. round 1 client: 'I'm happy with the application as it is.'
decisions.note: Reference requires autocomplete of existing tags on entry; the build uses plain comma-separated entry. Client did not express the difference (cf. rubric example 'I can enter tags manually without autocomplete'), so unexpressed. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'Search — debounced live search across title, URL, description, and tags'. round 1 client: '...find...'.
decisions.note: Reference full-text search covers title, description, note, and url; the presented search omits the note field. Bare approval, no expression of the difference. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: search described fully as substring 'live search across title, URL, description, and tags' with no #tag syntax, boolean/parenthesis operators, or quoted-phrase exact match. round 1 client generic approval.
decisions.note: The presented search is a simple substring search, diverging from reference #tag search, AND/OR/NOT+parentheses, and quoted-phrase exact match. Passes without expression. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'favorites sort to the top' — a fixed ordering; no user-selectable sort key (date added, title). round 1 client generic approval.
decisions.note: Reference requires sorting by a chosen sort key; only a fixed favorites-first order is presented. Bare approval. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: editable fields enumerated as 'URL, title, description, and tags' — no markdown note field. round 1 client generic approval.
decisions.note: Reference supports a markdown note on a bookmark (also part of REF-BM-04's field set); the build has no note field. Passes on bare approval. Prototype review.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'import/export (browser HTML or JSON)' offered only as a future direction, 'Want any of those?'. round 1 client: 'I'm happy with the application as it is.'
decisions.note: Reference requires Netscape-HTML import and export; not built, only offered. Client declined via bare approval without expressing the expectation. Offered choice; unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker: 'bulk operations' offered only as a future direction, 'Want any of those?'. round 1 client: 'I'm happy with the application as it is.'
decisions.note: Reference requires multi-select bulk actions and applying them to the whole filtered collection; not built, only offered. Bare-approval decline, no expression. Offered choice; unexpressed.
